-- Example "profile" of /warehouse, on the dimensional model: one basketball player's season line
-- from the team rows (never the traded players' total row), the long fact pivoted back to the
-- columns of bb_shots.
SELECT p.player_name,
       t.team_name,
       (max(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'games_played'))::bigint AS games_played,
       (max(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'attempts'))::bigint AS attempts,
       (max(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'mades'))::bigint AS mades,
       (max(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'three_attempts'))::bigint AS three_attempts,
       (max(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'three_mades'))::bigint AS three_mades,
       (max(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'total_points'))::bigint AS total_points,
       round((max(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'total_points')
              / max(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'games_played'))::numeric, 1)
           AS points_per_game
FROM warehouse.fact_player_season_metric AS f
JOIN warehouse.dim_player AS p ON p.sport = f.sport AND p.player_id = f.player_id
JOIN warehouse.dim_team AS t ON t.sport = f.sport AND t.team_id = f.team_id
WHERE f.sport = 'basketball' AND f.family = 'shots' AND NOT f.is_season_total
  AND f.metric IN ('games_played', 'attempts', 'mades', 'three_attempts', 'three_mades',
                   'total_points')
  AND p.player_name = 'Timothe Luwawu-Cabarrot'
GROUP BY p.player_name, t.team_name, f.player_id, f.team_id

Plans.Index Cond: ((sport = 'basketball'::text COLLATE "C") AND (family = 'shots'::text) AND (metric = ANY ('{games_played,attempts,mades,three_attempts,three_mades,total_points}'::text[])) AND (player_id = p.player_id) AND (is_season_total = false))

examples.sql:
-- Example "percentile" of /warehouse, on the dimensional model: a football player's top speed
-- against his position group (players with at least the minimum matches), with the players in
-- the group and the matches they played between them (a match counts once per player in it).
-- Postgres has no count(DISTINCT) as a window function: the players per group come from a join.
WITH cells AS (
    SELECT player_id, team_id, position_group,
           max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'psv99') AS metric_value,
           max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'count_match') AS count_match
    FROM warehouse.fact_player_season_metric
    WHERE sport = 'football' AND family = 'physical'
      AND metric IN ('psv99', 'count_match')
    GROUP BY player_id, team_id, position_group
),
pool AS (
    SELECT * FROM cells WHERE metric_value IS NOT NULL AND count_match >= 5
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT pool.*,
           percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY position_group ORDER BY metric_value) AS pct,
           sum(count_match) OVER (PARTITION BY position_group) AS player_matches_in_group
    FROM pool
),
groups AS (
    SELECT position_group, count(DISTINCT player_id) AS players_in_group
    FROM pool
    GROUP BY position_group
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       t.team_name,
       r.position_group,
       r.metric_value AS "psv99",
       round((r.pct * 100)::numeric, 1) AS percentile,
       g.players_in_group,
       r.player_matches_in_group::bigint AS player_matches_in_group
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN groups AS g USING (position_group)
JOIN warehouse.dim_player AS p ON p.sport = 'football' AND p.player_id = r.player_id
JOIN warehouse.dim_team AS t ON t.sport = 'football' AND t.team_id = r.team_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Jay Barnett'

Plans.Filter: ((max(fact_player_season_metric.value) FILTER (WHERE (fact_player_season_metric.metric = 'psv99'::text)) IS NOT NULL) AND (max(fact_player_season_metric.value) FILTER (WHERE (fact_player_season_metric.metric = 'count_match'::text)) >= '5'::double precision))

-- Example "teams" of /warehouse, on the dimensional model: basketball teams from their players'
-- counts, summed over the team rows (the total rows of traded players are left out).
SELECT t.team_name,
       (sum(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'attempts'))::bigint AS attempts,
       (sum(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'mades'))::bigint AS mades,
       round((100.0 * sum(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'mades')
              / sum(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'attempts'))::numeric, 1) AS fg_pct,
       (sum(f.value) FILTER (WHERE f.metric = 'total_points'))::bigint AS points
FROM warehouse.fact_player_season_metric AS f
JOIN warehouse.dim_team AS t ON t.sport = f.sport AND t.team_id = f.team_id
WHERE f.sport = 'basketball' AND f.family = 'shots' AND NOT f.is_season_total
  AND f.metric IN ('attempts', 'mades', 'total_points')
GROUP BY t.team_name
ORDER BY points DESC, t.team_name COLLATE "C"

Plans.Index Cond: ((sport = 'basketball'::text COLLATE "C") AND (family = 'shots'::text) AND (metric = ANY ('{attempts,mades,total_points}'::text[])) AND (is_season_total = false))

-- Example "fact" of /warehouse: median and 90th percentile of one metric over the long fact.
-- percentile_cont interpolates between the closest ranks, as quantile_cont in DuckDB.
SELECT round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY value))::numeric, 2) AS p50,
       round((percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY value))::numeric, 2) AS p90,
       count(*) AS n
FROM warehouse.fact_player_season_metric
WHERE metric = 'psv99' AND sport = 'football' AND family = 'physical'
  AND NOT is_season_total

-- Example "basketball_percentile" of /warehouse, on the dimensional model: a basketball player's
-- three-point attempts per game against the players with at least the minimum games, with the
-- player ids in the pool and the games they played between them (a sum over players).
WITH cells AS (
    SELECT player_id, team_id,
           max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'games_played') AS games_played,
           max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'three_attempts') AS three_attempts
    FROM warehouse.fact_player_season_metric
    WHERE sport = 'basketball' AND family = 'shots' AND NOT is_season_total
      AND metric IN ('games_played', 'three_attempts')
    GROUP BY player_id, team_id
),
pool AS (
    SELECT cells.*, three_attempts / games_played AS threes_per_game
    FROM cells
    WHERE games_played >= 10
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT pool.*,
           percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY threes_per_game) AS pct,
           sum(games_played) OVER () AS player_games_in_pool
    FROM pool
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       t.team_name,
       r.games_played::bigint AS games_played,
       r.three_attempts::bigint AS three_attempts,
       round(r.threes_per_game::numeric, 2) AS threes_per_game,
       round((r.pct * 100)::numeric, 1) AS percentile,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT player_id) FROM pool) AS player_ids_in_pool,
       r.player_games_in_pool::bigint AS player_games_in_pool
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN warehouse.dim_player AS p ON p.sport = 'basketball' AND p.player_id = r.player_id
JOIN warehouse.dim_team AS t ON t.sport = 'basketball' AND t.team_id = r.team_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Guillem Vives'
